runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **HK$1.315** H share (close 2026-10-16, aggregator, flagged), **US$3.35 an ADR** at 20 H shares per ADR (F-6EF 2019-11-22, `0001193805-19-001645`); A share RMB 2.58, about 2.3 times the H share for the same claim; the ADR's last quote US$3.21 at zero volume, stale, not used. Shares **20,476,120,463** outstanding (A 17,670,935,463; H 2,805,185,000; 2026 Interim Report, HKEX 2026-09-17, file 2026091700586, less repurchased shares held); market value RMB 48.7 bn at the A and H prices, RMB 23.0 bn at the H price for every share. Sovereign **2.06%** (RMB: 30-year China Government Bond Yield Curve of the Ministry of Finance of the PRC, served by China Central Depository & Clearing, 2026-10-16; a CONVENTION of the run, the protocol's table has no RMB row). No SEC financial filings (CIK 0001485888 carries F-6 forms only); read from HKEXnews, stock code 1618: the 2025 Annual Report (2026-04-17, file 2026041700852, Deloitte, unqualified), the 2026 Interim Report, the annual reports for 2016 to 2024, the very substantial disposal circular (2025-12-12, file 2025121201700) and the 2025 results estimate (2026-01-23, file 2026012301104); one set of ASBE statements for A and H holders, English translation read. Cross-check: 2025 operating cash flow RMB 15,322,753 thousand agrees in the data table and the cash flow statement. `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` returned nothing for a non-SEC filer; every figure by script in the research folder. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 2025 report's Section IV (seven, listed in the run file). Rivals: the report names none; China Railway Group (0390) and China Railway Construction (1186) read as the analyst's choice, neither an SEC filer; China Communications Construction not read. **Q1 IN** (after the December 2025 sale of the real-estate and resources businesses to China Minmetals for RMB 60.7 bn, an engineering contractor with a small featured business; engineering contracting revenue RMB 408 bn in 2025, orders in hand RMB 2,731 bn). **Q2 OUT** **[L2004-003]**, **[M2017-009]**, **[M1997-010]**, **[L1994-035]**, **[L2007-004]**, **[M2011-015]**: engineering contracting carries about 102% of five-year total profit and decides; work won by public tender, the company's own risk section calling the field one of "homogeneous scale"; engineering contracting gross margin from 12.54% (2015) to 9.54% (2025); aggregate pre-tax margin 2015 to 2025 MCC 2.53% against China Railway Group 3.48% and China Railway Construction 3.19%, mean pre-tax return on total equity 8.12% against 10.82% and 10.40%, MCC below both rivals on margin every year 2019 to 2025; return on ordinary equity 10.47% (2022) to 0.05% (2025). After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: the related-party disposal of December 2025 after a RMB 25.7 bn write-down of the real-estate equity; 2025 impairments over RMB 26 bn left ordinary holders RMB 46 million against RMB 1,275 million paid to perpetual-bond holders; the parent company's accumulated loss of RMB 2.79 bn, no 2025 dividend; RMB 54 bn of perpetual bonds; receivables, contract assets and long-term receivables from 41-51% of revenue (2019 to 2023) to 110% (2025, RMB 499 bn), payables from 43% to 93%. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash (all-equity, operating cash flow less all capital spending, interest a financing flow under ASBE) RMB 14.18, 13.49, 1.31, 0.98, 9.05 bn 2021 to 2025, average **RMB 7.80 bn**; value range **RMB 1.84 to 13.46 a share, US$5.50 to 40.23 an ADR**; no case earns the floor at the price (6.2% no-growth at the H price); fair price **none positive, RMB (2.17) a share all-equity** (RMB 103.1 bn of net debt, perpetual bonds and minority interests counted ahead of the ordinary shares, a CONVENTION of the run that decides the figure; net debt alone gives 17.8% at the H price), **RMB 1.02 a share, US$3.06 an ADR equity-only** beside; not armed. Contamination declared by the analyst: the session-start git status and MAGH commit subjects, AYI and ARCB research-folder names, memory index lines; none used. Commits 4c48ab5e (template), 819f545d (Step 0), 3a7cb6bf (Q1), 3b9564ec (Q2 and box), 2609e46c (the rest). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_run.py` clean; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_check.py`, 22 fragments closing before an id, none outside its row; no E-ids; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) the all-equity bridge silent on perpetual bonds and minority interests, which decide this name; (2) no rule for A and H classes of one claim quoted 2.3 times apart; (3) specific (c) read literally would count segment-sale cash already in net debt as owner cash; (4) no RMB row in the sovereign table. Could not get: China Communications Construction; the rivals' 2020; any sweep of penalties or litigation; the Chinese original.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2 (Metallurgical Corporation of China, HKEX 1618, OTC ADR MLLUY; a Chinese state engineering contractor, after selling its real-estate and resources businesses to its controlling shareholder in December 2025, whose deciding part wins work by public tender in a field of "homogeneous scale", gross margin 12.54% to 9.54% over 2015 to 2025, pre-tax margin and return below China Railway Group and China Railway Construction every year since 2019. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: the related-party disposal after a RMB 25.7 bn write-down, RMB 26 bn+ of 2025 impairments, perpetual-bond coupons far above ordinary profit, receivables at 110% of revenue. Computation beneath the stop: value RMB 1.84 to 13.46 a share, no case earning the floor, fair price negative all-equity, RMB 1.02 equity-only, not armed. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: perpetual bonds and minorities in the all-equity bridge, A and H prices for one claim, segment-sale cash in specific (c), no RMB sovereign row.)
